reply: t is close to −2.8·√t, but that pattern breaks down at higher P. A full basis of P-powers times t-functions fits to about 4e-7, so the true structure is close to that family. I could not identify a sparse closed form from it, and the last few parametric families I tried all stalled at 1e-3 or worse.

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    sP=np.sqrt(P)
    return (-(p[0]+p[1]*sP+p[2]*P+p[3]*P**2)*np.abs(t)**p[4]
            -(p[5]+p[6]*P+p[7]*P**2)*np.log(1+t)
            -p[8]*P*t - p[9]*P*np.sqrt(1+t))
